steps.cap: A scanner prints at most a rectangle 26 by 33 mm in one exposure, which sets the practical limit on the size of one die.
An AI accelerator needs more circuit than that, so its logic is split across two dies.
The dies sit side by side on an interposer, a base with wiring fine enough to join them.
Eight stacks of high-bandwidth memory go beside them, joined by more wires than a resin board can carry.
The interposer is mounted on a resin substrate. TSMC now builds interposers up to 5.5 times the area of one exposure.
